design_philosophy: Premium, Modern, Minimal, Calm, Professional, Timeless, Confident editorial aesthetic. Feel like ONE seamless product across Marketing, Booking, and Admin Dashboard.

colors.system_rules: 85% Matte Black / Charcoal / Dark Gray, 12% White / Soft Gray, 3% Deep Crimson Red. Red reserved ONLY for Primary CTA, Booking Progress, Hover States, Selected Nav, Important Actions — NEVER red-dominant layouts.

spacing_and_layout.system: 8-point scale (Tailwind default), but use 2-3x generous whitespace. Containers padded well.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento-style asymmetry for featured areas, structured dense grid for Admin.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical alignment, text mostly left-aligned for clear reading flow. Editorial asymmetry used in marketing pages.

surfaces_and_components.card: Flat, sharp edges or max 4px radius. 1px subtle border (#2C2C2C). NO heavy drop shadows. Hover: subtle lift (-translate-y-1) and slightly lighter border.
surfaces_and_components.button: Sharp or minimal rounding (rounded-sm). Primary: Matte Red background with white text. Secondary: Transparent with 1px border. Focus/Active states must maintain high contrast.
surfaces_and_components.navigation: Sticky nav. Solid dark background (#0A0A0A) or extremely subtle blur with 95% opacity. Red CTA button.
surfaces_and_components.booking_wizard: Dedicated page. Progress bar with thin red indicator. Clean step-by-step layout without clutter. Summary on the side or bottom. Razorpay payment step.
surfaces_and_components.admin_dashboard: Dark editorial layout (not SaaS light). Dense structured grids for tables, clean sidebar, typography focused KPI cards.

rules: No aggressive parallax or bouncy springs.
Smooth fades (opacity) and slight transforms (y-axis translation) on scroll.
Hover states: quick transition (150ms-200ms ease) on buttons and cards.

marketing: Hero (cinematic multi-slide: Welcome, Precision, Transformation, Confidence)
booking: Category -> Service -> Professional -> Date -> Time -> Customer Details -> Review -> Payment -> Confirmation

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `lucide-react` for icons if needed, and `framer-motion` for subtle animations.
Apply `data-testid` to all interactive elements for robust testing.
Do not use generic SaaS look (no standard white boxes with drop shadows). Always maintain the matte black base with deep charcoal sections.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for marketing layout. For admin/forms, use Shadcn but stripped of 'Vercel-look' borders/shadows to match editorial theme.
Use Shadcn form, inputs, and tables for Admin dashboard and Booking flow.
Ensure high contrast WCAG AA compliance across text against dark backgrounds.
Admin layout should feel luxurious but functional, not cluttered.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. No center-everything layouts.
Create depth using layered matte tones instead of bright gradients.
NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds on headers that scroll over content.
Never apply universal transition like `transition: all`.
